title: UN Commission finding on destruction of Gaza's education system
summary: The Commission assessed damage to schools and universities and the long-term effects on education in Gaza.
claim: The Commission found that Israeli attacks since October 2023 effectively destroyed Gaza's education system and that deliberate, unnecessary burning and demolition of schools violated international humanitarian law principles.
legal_characterization: Factual and legal findings by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraphs 76-80 of A/HRC/59/26. The record is limited to the Commission's education-system findings and does not independently infer legal responsibility beyond the report.
